links.outcome: Performance consistency across semantically equivalent prompts varying in literacy and prompting expertise
links.effect: Statistically significant performance disparities between low-literacy and expert-prompting cohorts on MedQA; applying PET eliminated the disparities while preserving semantic fidelity.
links.quote: Experiments on the MedQA benchmark demonstrate measurable prompt privilege, with statistically significant performance disparities between low-literacy and expert-prompting cohorts.
